sections.text: Michael De Santa, having briefly encountered the Epsilon Program when they kidnapped and abandoned him in the Grand Senora Desert, goes to a non-descript building in Downtown Vinewood to meet a representative for the group. Michael meets Marnie Allen, a former drug addict and prostitute, who tells Michael of her past and how she found the truth when joining the Epsilon Program. She and Tom, who enters the building during the conversation, attempt to convince Michael to join the group by donating a further $ 5,000 for an education tool. Marnie and Tom leave allowing the player to have Michael donate the money through the Epsilon Program's website.

sections.title: What happens (Grand Theft Wiki, abridged)
sections.text: Michael meets with Marnie Allen in an alleyway in Vinewood. She tells him that he must buy the Epsilon robes from the official Epsilon Program website for $ 25,000 and wear the robes for 10 consecutive days. After ordering the robes, it takes 24 in-game hours for the robes to arrive at Michael's wardrobe. If Michael removes the robes at any time, the day counter is reset. After wearing the robes for 10 in-game days, Michael will receive a text message telling him to meet Tom near Fort Zancudo for his next task.

sections.title: What happens (Grand Theft Wiki, abridged)
sections.text: Along the shore of the Land Act Reservoir in the Tataviam Mountains, Franklin meets the same dog he discovered in Risk Assessment. Following the dog's guidance, Franklin heads to the Land Act Dam. There, he sees Dom preparing to jump from the dam without a parachute. After psyching himself up and taunting Franklin a final time, Dom jumps and, predictably, dies on impact. At this point, the player can complete the mission simply by walking away. The player can also complete the mission by jumping from the dam (there is a stairway and ladder to the left of where Dom jumped) and parachuting down to the river below.
